docs.name: Assessment Evaluation
docs.purpose: Upload a question paper and students' answer sheets, then have AI evaluate them. Files move through three statuses so you can see what still needs attention.
steps: Press Upload Assessment. The Upload Assessment Files box opens.

Under Question Paper, choose an earlier paper from Choose a question paper, or upload a new one (PDF or image) and give it a title such as Mid-Term Maths. If there are none yet the list says No question papers uploaded yet.
Under Answer Sheets click to browse, or drag your answer sheet files in.
Optionally fill in Class, Section, Subject and Student Name. These can be filled in later. Student Name is available once Class and Section are chosen.
Press the upload button at the bottom of the box. It stays disabled until you have added at least one answer sheet and chosen or added a question paper. Cancel closes the box.
Open the Pending tab. Tick the files you want evaluated (Select all ticks all of them), then press Evaluate Selected with AI. You can also use the evaluate button on a single file.
When evaluation finishes the files move to the AI Reviewed tab. Use the view button on a file to preview it.
notes: You see Uploaded followed by the number of files, and later an AI evaluation complete message with how many files succeeded. Any that failed are reported with the reason.
problems: Upload says you need to add an answer sheet. - Add at least one answer sheet file before uploading.
Upload says to choose the question paper. - Choose an existing question paper from the list.
Upload says to upload the question paper. - Switch to uploading a new question paper and add the file, then upload again.

docs.name: Attendance
docs.purpose: Mark attendance for a class, look back at saved records, and see your own attendance on My Attendance. Teachers also get an Attendance Risk tab.
steps: Open the Student Attendance tab.
Choose the class from Select class. Each choice shows the class name and its section.
Choose the date in the date box.
If a Period box appears, choose the period (Period 1, Period 2 and so on). It only appears when your school marks attendance by period.
Wait for the student list to load. Each student shows their name and roll number.
Set a status for each student: Present, Absent, Late, Half Day or Excused. To save time press Mark all present first and then change the exceptions.
Check the counter showing how many students you have marked out of the total.
Press Save Attendance.
notes: You see Attendance saved. If you left students unmarked it says, for example, that attendance was saved for some of the students and that some are still unmarked. Unmarked students are skipped, never assumed present. Parents of the students you marked receive an Attendance Update notification. If you save the same class and date again, the existing records are updated.
problems: The student list is empty. - That class and section has no active students. Check that you picked the right class, otherwise ask your school admin.
Some students were not saved. - A student you did not mark is skipped on purpose. Mark the remaining students and press Save Attendance again.
Saving shows an error. - The message after Error says what failed. Press Save Attendance again and, if it keeps failing, give the message to your school admin.
docs.content:
Attendance
Where: Left menu, Attendance.
What it is: Mark attendance for a class, look back at saved records, and see your own attendance on My Attendance. Teachers also get an Attendance Risk tab.
How to use it: (1) Open the Student Attendance tab. (2) Choose the class from Select class. Each choice shows the class name and its section. (3) Choose the date in the date box. (4) If a Period box appears, choose the period (Period 1, Period 2 and so on). It only appears when your school marks attendance by period. (5) Wait for the student list to load. Each student shows their name and roll number. (6) Set a status for each student: Present, Absent, Late, Half Day or Excused. To save time press Mark all present first and then change the exceptions. (7) Check the counter showing how many students you have marked out of the total. (8) Press Save Attendance.
Good to know: You see Attendance saved. If you left students unmarked it says, for example, that attendance was saved for some of the students and that some are still unmarked. Unmarked students are skipped, never assumed present. Parents of the students you marked receive an Attendance Update notification. If you save the same class and date again, the existing records are updated.
If something goes wrong: The student list is empty. - That class and section has no active students. Check that you picked the right class, otherwise ask your school admin. Some students were not saved. - A student you did not mark is skipped on purpose. Mark the remaining students and press Save Attendance again. Saving shows an error. - The message after Error says what failed. Press Save Attendance again and, if it keeps failing, give the message to your school admin.

docs.name: Worksheet Submissions
docs.purpose: Review the answers students submitted on worksheets. You can let AI review them, then check, adjust and finalise the score and feedback yourself.
steps: Find the submission in the list. Its badge says Pending Review, AI Reviewed or Reviewed.
Press AI Review on the submission, or AI Review All Pending to do all of them. Wait for the success message that shows the score.
Open the submission. Under AI Evaluation Results read the suggested score and feedback.
Type the Score you want to give. The box shows the AI's suggestion; leaving it empty saves no score. Use a number that is not negative.
Type the feedback for the student in the feedback box. Its hint text shows the AI's feedback if there is one.
Press Approve & Finalize.
notes: You see Marked as reviewed and feedback saved, the badge becomes Reviewed, and the student and the parent are notified that the worksheet has been reviewed.
problems: The score is rejected. - Type a plain number that is zero or higher, or leave the box empty.
AI Review All Pending does nothing. - There is nothing waiting. New submissions appear after students hand in worksheets.
AI review failed. - The message after it explains the cause. Press AI Review again. In a bulk review, the success message tells you how many failed so you can retry those.
docs.content:
Worksheet Submissions
Where: Left menu, Worksheet Submissions.
What it is: Review the answers students submitted on worksheets. You can let AI review them, then check, adjust and finalise the score and feedback yourself.
How to use it: (1) Find the submission in the list. Its badge says Pending Review, AI Reviewed or Reviewed. (2) Press AI Review on the submission, or AI Review All Pending to do all of them. Wait for the success message that shows the score. (3) Open the submission. Under AI Evaluation Results read the suggested score and feedback. (4) Type the Score you want to give. The box shows the AI's suggestion; leaving it empty saves no score. Use a number that is not negative. (5) Type the feedback for the student in the feedback box. Its hint text shows the AI's feedback if there is one. (6) Press Approve & Finalize.
Good to know: You see Marked as reviewed and feedback saved, the badge becomes Reviewed, and the student and the parent are notified that the worksheet has been reviewed.
If something goes wrong: The score is rejected. - Type a plain number that is zero or higher, or leave the box empty. AI Review All Pending does nothing. - There is nothing waiting. New submissions appear after students hand in worksheets. AI review failed. - The message after it explains the cause. Press AI Review again. In a bulk review, the success message tells you how many failed so you can retry those.
